name: @pipeworx/mcp-pvgis

tools.name: pv_performance
tools.description: Model annual + monthly PV system output. Returns kWh/year estimates and monthly breakdowns.

angle.description: Tilt angle in degrees from horizontal. Default 35.

pvtechchoice.description: crystSi | CIS | CdTe | Unknown. Default crystSi.

tools.name: monthly_radiation
tools.description: Long-term monthly average global / diffuse / direct irradiation on horizontal / inclined plane.

startyear.description: Earliest year, defaults to climate database start

tools.name: tmy
tools.description: Typical Meteorological Year — hourly synthetic year representative of the climate.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pvgis forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pvgis pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
